tEn: Claude Opus 5.5 Should Raise Your Ambitions
tZh: Claude Opus 5.5 应提升你的期望
sEn: Claude Opus 5.5 delivers Fable-5.1-level performance at a lower price, making it the new default model for most tasks.
sZh: Claude Opus 5.5 以更低价格实现 Fable-5.1 级别的性能，成为大多数任务的新默认模型。
absEn: Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 delivers Fable-5.1-level performance at a lower Opus-level price, with benchmark results that are almost universally better than every model except GPT-6 Astra and usually above Astra, placing it in a clear overall lead in intelligence according to Artificial Analysis. The article argues that Opus 5.5 is the new default model for most tasks, excelling in agentic coding, 3D understanding, vision, communication, and reliability, while Fable 5.1 retains an edge in expert-domain correctness and out-of-distribution creativity. Pricing is $4/$20, 20% lower than Opus 5, with estimated overall costs typically dropping 40% and speed up 30%, and subscription limits increased. The conclusion is that readers should raise their ambitions, calibrate thinking levels, and test models for their own use cases, using Opus 5.5 by default, Fable 5.1 for domain correctness, and Astra for ambitious coding or web search.
absZh: Anthropic 的 Claude Opus 5.5 以更低的 Opus 级价格实现了 Fable-5.1 级别的性能，其基准测试结果几乎全面优于除 GPT-6 Astra 之外的所有模型，且通常高于 Astra，根据 Artificial Analysis 的评估，它在智能方面处于明显的整体领先地位。文章认为，Opus 5.5 是大多数任务的新默认模型，在智能体编程、3D 理解、视觉、沟通和可靠性方面表现出色，而 Fable 5.1 在专家领域正确性和分布外创造力方面仍具优势。定价为 $4/$20，比 Opus 5 低 20%，预计整体成本通常下降 40%，速度提升 30%，订阅限额也有所增加。结论是，读者应提升自己的期望、校准思考层级，并针对自身用例测试模型：默认使用 Opus 5.5，需要领域正确性时使用 Fable 5.1，进行高难度编程或网络搜索时使用 Astra。

contrib.en: Opus 5.5 matches Fable 5.1-level performance at 20% lower price, with typical costs down 40% and speed up 30%.
contrib.zh: Opus 5.5 以低 20% 的价格达到 Fable 5.1 级性能，典型成本下降 40%、速度提升 30%。

contrib.en: Artificial Analysis ranks Opus 5.5 first in overall intelligence at 58, usually above GPT-6 Astra on benchmarks.
contrib.zh: Artificial Analysis 将 Opus 5.5 的整体智能排名列为第一（58 分），基准测试通常高于 GPT-6 Astra。

contrib.en: Excels in agentic coding, 3D understanding, vision, communication and reliability, becoming the new default model.
contrib.zh: 在智能体式编程、3D 理解、视觉、沟通与可靠性上表现出色，成为新的默认模型。

contrib.en: Fable 5.1 retains an edge in expert-domain correctness and out-of-distribution creativity; Astra leads ambitious coding and web search.
contrib.zh: Fable 5.1 在专家领域正确性与分布外创造力上仍占优；Astra 在雄心编程与网络搜索上领先。

contrib.en: Notably improved writing and communication, with more natural prose and better adherence to user writing rules.
contrib.zh: 写作与沟通显著改进，行文更自然，更遵循用户写作规则。

contrib.en: Hallucinates less and admits uncertainty more often, winning Omniscience despite slightly fewer correct answers.
contrib.zh: 幻觉更少、更常承认不确定，尽管正确答案略少仍在 Omniscience 上胜出。

limits.en: Falls short of Fable 5.1 on domain-answer correctness benchmarks where presentation and writing do not matter.
limits.zh: 在只看领域答案正确性、不重表达与写作的基准上不及 Fable 5.1。

limits.en: At max thinking it uses so many tokens that cost slightly exceeds Opus 5 and nears Fable 5.1.
limits.zh: 在最大思考档位下 token 消耗过多，成本略高于 Opus 5 并接近 Fable 5.1。

limits.en: Occasionally emits gibberish or illogical sentences, and struggles with complex nested meaning and inferring non-obvious intent.
limits.zh: 偶尔输出胡言乱语或不合逻辑的句子，在复杂嵌套语义与非显式意图推断上吃力。

limits.en: Classifiers still misfire on some legitimate tasks, and prompt injection defense filters research through a weaker model summary.
limits.zh: 分类器仍会误拦部分正当任务，提示注入防御让研究内容经由较弱模型摘要过滤。

limits.en: Some report overeager autonomous actions, such as crashing staging servers or killing local apps, and occasional laziness.
limits.zh: 有反馈称其自主行动过于冒进，如搞崩预发服务器或杀掉本地应用，且偶有偷懒。

paras.en: The pitch is Fable-5.1-level performance at a lower Opus-level price. Good pitch.
paras.zh: 其宣传口径是：以更低的 Opus 级价格，实现 Fable-5.1 级的性能。不错的宣传。

paras.en: We're introducing Claude Opus 5.5, the first model in our new Claude 5.5 family. It performs at the level of Claude Fable 5.1 on most work and costs 40% less to run than Opus 5.
paras.zh: 我们推出 Claude Opus 5.5，这是我们全新 Claude 5.5 家族中的首个模型。它在大多数工作上都能达到 Claude Fable 5.1 的水平，而运行成本比 Opus 5 低 40%。

paras.en: They could have reasonably pitched this as above-Fable-5.1-level performance. A better pitch, but Anthropic tends to keep its pitches conservative.
paras.zh: 他们本可以合理地将其宣传为超越 Fable-5.1 级的性能。那样宣传会更好，但 Anthropic 倾向于保持其宣传口径的保守性。

paras.en: They highlight agentic coding, security, and improved communications.
paras.zh: 他们重点强调了智能体式编程、安全性以及改进的沟通能力。

paras.en: The early-tester blurbs are flagged as AI-generated, and they have a set for each feature area. They praise agentic coding skills, efficiency, readability and communication, and the ability to effectively run on its own for extended periods, as well as increased reliability, pitching it as a major upgrade.
paras.zh: 早期测试者的推荐语被标注为 AI 生成，且每个功能领域都有一组对应的推荐语。他们称赞其智能体式编程能力、效率、可读性与沟通能力，以及长时间自主有效运行的能力和更高的可靠性，并将其宣传为一次重大升级。

paras.en: Benchmarks look fantastic, with occasional spots where Astra or Fable is still ahead.
paras.zh: 基准测试结果看起来非常出色，只是偶尔在某些点上 Astra 或 Fable 仍然领先。

paras.en: Opus 5.5 is available with zero data retention (ZDR). Given it is at least as capable as Fable 5.1, and clearly more capable on cyber tasks (they say 'extremely strong' cyber capabilities), this seems unprincipled. They have a technical explanation but I do not buy it. From where I sit, either Fable 5.1 can have ZDR, or Opus 5.5 can't.
paras.zh: Opus 5.5 提供零数据保留（ZDR）。鉴于它至少与 Fable 5.1 能力相当，且在网络安全任务上明显更强（他们称其具备“极强”的网络安全能力），这似乎有失原则。他们有一套技术解释，但我并不买账。在我看来，要么 Fable 5.1 可以拥有 ZDR，要么 Opus 5.5 不能。

paras.en: Sholto Douglas highlights improved ability to understand and model in 3D, and also a key double-edged sword.
paras.zh: Sholto Douglas 强调了在理解和建模 3D 方面能力的提升，同时也指出了一把关键的双刃剑。

paras.en: Sholto Douglas (Anthropic): also important news we fixed the writing
paras.zh: Sholto Douglas（Anthropic）：还有一条重要消息，我们修复了写作问题

paras.en: Tom Brown: Plus we fixed the accent
paras.zh: Tom Brown：另外我们修复了口音问题

paras.en: Claude: Opus 5.5 communicates more naturally, addressing some of the most common feedback we heard on Opus 5. It puts the most important information up front and follows the writing rules you give it, which makes long sessions easier to follow.
paras.zh: Claude：Opus 5.5 的交流更加自然，回应了我们在 Opus 5 上收到的一些最常见反馈。它把最重要的信息放在前面，并遵循你给它的写作规则，这让长会话更容易跟进。

paras.en: Ado was one of many praising how easy Opus 5.5 is to work with and talk to.
paras.zh: Ado 是众多称赞 Opus 5.5 易于协作与交流的人之一。

paras.en: Ado (Anthropic): If you loved how Opus 4.6 felt to work with, Opus 5.5 feels like coming home. Same easy back-and-forth with a lot more horsepower underneath. It's the most fun I've had in Claude Code in a while.
paras.zh: Ado（Anthropic）：如果你喜欢 Opus 4.6 的协作手感，那么 Opus 5.5 会让你有种回家的感觉。同样轻松的来回交流，底下却多了强劲得多的马力。这是我在 Claude Code 里一段时间以来玩得最开心的一次。

paras.en: It's also much cheaper (~40% less than Opus 5 on typical workloads).
paras.zh: 它还便宜得多（在典型工作负载下比 Opus 5 低约 40%）。

paras.en: Why release Opus 5.5 when you have to Pace the Frontier? That's a whole 0.5 of Opus.
paras.zh: 既然你必须 Pace the Frontier，为什么还要发布 Opus 5.5？那可是整整 0.5 个 Opus。

paras.en: Sam Bowman: We think Opus 5.5 is sufficiently safer than its predecessors that releasing it, more likely than not, reduces risks related to misalignment.
paras.zh: Sam Bowman：我们认为 Opus 5.5 比其前代模型足够安全，因此发布它很可能降低与失准（misalignment）相关的风险。

paras.en: I agree that not releasing would not help matters, given the model exists. The real frontier is training new internal models. We don't get to see it in real time.
paras.zh: 我同意，鉴于该模型已经存在，不发布也无济于事。真正的前沿在于训练新的内部模型。我们无法实时看到这一过程。

paras.en: Pricing is $4/$20, 20% lower than Opus 5, and $0.20 for the cache which is 60% lower. They estimate overall costs will typically drop 40%, while speed is up 30%. Limits on subscriptions have been increased.
paras.zh: 定价为 $4/$20，比 Opus 5 低 20%，缓存价格为 $0.20，低 60%。他们估计总体成本通常将下降 40%，而速度提升 30%。订阅限额已提高。

paras.en: Fast mode is available at $8/$40, with up to 2.5x the speed. I'd be tempted.
paras.zh: 快速模式的价格为 $8/$40，速度最高可达 2.5 倍。我有点心动。

paras.en: This is all a very good price for Fable or Astra level performance.
paras.zh: 对于 Fable 或 Astra 级别的性能来说，这都是非常划算的价格。

paras.en: OpenAI focused on lower costs, with GPT-6 Sol prices cut 50% to $2/$10 and Luna cut to only $0.10/$0.50. OpenAI wants you to mix and match models depending on task level. GPT-6 Sol and Luna are pitched as big quality improvements over their old versions, but Sol is not pitched as matching Astra.
paras.zh: OpenAI 专注于降低成本，将 GPT-6 Sol 的价格下调 50% 至 $2/$10，Luna 则降至仅 $0.10/$0.50。OpenAI 希望用户根据任务级别混合搭配模型。GPT-6 Sol 和 Luna 被宣传为相较旧版本有大幅质量提升，但 Sol 并未被宣传为可与 Astra 匹敌。

paras.en: Sam Altman (CEO OpenAI): GPT-6 Sol and Luna are big improvements on intelligence, alignment, work output, coding, computer use, and more over their 5.6-family predecessors. They are also half the price per token, and even less per task!
paras.zh: Sam Altman（OpenAI CEO）：GPT-6 Sol 和 Luna 在智能、对齐、工作产出、编程、计算机使用等方面，相较其 5.6 系列前代产品均有大幅提升。它们的每 token 价格也减半，而每任务成本甚至更低！

paras.en: Whereas Claude now essentially says you should use Opus 5.5 for most tasks.
paras.zh: 而 Claude 现在基本上是说，大多数任务都应该使用 Opus 5.5。

paras.en: As I said, that's a strong pitch across the board.
paras.zh: 正如我所说，这是一个全面而有力的卖点。

paras.en: They are very good benchmarks. Opus 5.5 is almost universally better on benchmarks than every model except Astra, and is usually above Astra.
paras.zh: 这些基准测试非常出色。除 Astra 外，Opus 5.5 在基准测试上几乎普遍优于所有模型，且通常高于 Astra。

paras.en: They add various additional scores, including via graphs, and they mostly look like this, although many are missing Astra from the chart:
paras.zh: 他们还添加了各种额外分数，包括以图表形式呈现，且大多看起来像这样，尽管许多图表中缺少 Astra：

paras.en: It goes on like this, and I don't think it is worth anyone's time to go through it.
paras.zh: 情况一直如此，我认为不值得任何人花时间去逐一查看。

paras.en: Artificial Analysis places Opus 5.5 in a clear overall lead in intelligence at 58.
paras.zh: Artificial Analysis 将 Opus 5.5 列为智能总体领先，得分为 58。

paras.en: As tested on max, Opus 5.5 uses so many tokens that it is slightly more expensive than Opus 5, and only slightly cheaper than Fable 5.1.
paras.zh: 在 max 设置下测试时，Opus 5.5 使用的 token 数量如此之多，以至于它比 Opus 5 略贵，仅比 Fable 5.1 略便宜。

paras.en: You can also run it cheaper, and often should. Opus 5.5 on medium, high and xhigh settings are all on the dotted line that marks the intelligence-cost frontier, as are GPT-6 Luna, GPT-6 Sol and MiMo v2.6 Pro.
paras.zh: 你也可以以更低的成本运行它，而且通常应该这样做。Opus 5.5 在 medium、high 和 xhigh 设置下都位于标记智能-成本前沿的虚线上，GPT-6 Luna、GPT-6 Sol 和 MiMo v2.6 Pro 也是如此。

paras.en: As its five-point lead indicates, Opus 5.5 dominates Astra across most of AA's tracked benchmarks, including big leads in AA-Briefcase, GDPval-AA SciCode, AA-Omniscience Index and HLE. Astra's biggest lead is in GDP.pdf.
paras.zh: 正如其五分领先优势所示，Opus 5.5 在 AA 追踪的大多数基准测试中主导 Astra，包括在 AA-Briefcase、GDPval-AA SciCode、AA-Omniscience Index 和 HLE 中的大幅领先。Astra 的最大领先在 GDP.pdf 中。

paras.en: Artificial Analysis adds the new Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1, with GPT-6 Astra at 63% and Opus 5.5 on xhigh at 62%. No other model breaks 50%.
paras.zh: Artificial Analysis 新增了 Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1，GPT-6 Astra 达到 63%，Opus 5.5 在 xhigh 下为 62%。没有其他模型突破 50%。

paras.en: Opus 5.5 wins on Omniscience (46 versus 43 for both Fable 5.1 and Astra) despite slightly fewer right answers, because it guesses (or hallucinates) less, and is willing to more often admit it doesn't know.
paras.zh: Opus 5.5 在 Omniscience 上获胜（46 分，而 Fable 5.1 和 Astra 均为 43 分），尽管正确答案略少，因为它猜测（或幻觉）更少，并且更愿意承认自己不知道。

paras.en: WeirdML v3 still has Astra out in front at 42.2%, with Opus 5.5 in clear second at 31.2% with Fable 5.1 in third at 26%. The best non-OpenAI, non-Anthropic model is Kimi K3 at 7.3%.
paras.zh: WeirdML v3 中 Astra 仍以 42.2% 领先，Opus 5.5 以 31.2% 稳居第二，Fable 5.1 以 26% 位列第三。表现最好的非 OpenAI、非 Anthropic 模型是 Kimi K3，为 7.3%。

paras.en: James Moughan: In my testing it's stronger overall than every other model and cracks a couple of questions nothing else has. And then just occasionally it randomly emits a sentence that is totally gibberish and illogical. It's fun to talk to. Still a huge math nerd. Odd but very good.
paras.zh: James Moughan：在我的测试中，它整体上比其他所有模型都更强，还能解出其他模型都解不出的几道题。但偶尔它会随机冒出一句完全不知所云、毫无逻辑的话。和它聊天很有趣。它仍然是个十足的数理迷。古怪但非常出色。

paras.en: If you like benchmarks, here is the Chart of Utter Abomination, updated.
paras.zh: 如果你喜欢基准测试，这里是更新后的“彻头彻尾的灾难图表”。

paras.en: The places Opus 5.5 falls short of Fable 5.1 fall into a pattern. Fable 5.1 takes all seven Vals professionals rows, as well as MedCode, SAGE and both MLCRs.
paras.zh: Opus 5.5 落后于 Fable 5.1 的地方呈现出一种规律。Fable 5.1 拿下了 Vals professionals 的全部七行，以及 MedCode、SAGE 和两个 MLCR。

paras.en: My Opus 5.5 speculates that this cluster is 'domain answer graded purely for correctness.' When presentation and writing do not matter, Fable 5.1's advantages dominate. When other output details matter, both AIs and humans prefer Opus 5.5.
paras.zh: 我的 Opus 5.5 推测，这一簇是“仅按正确性评分的领域答案”。当呈现与写作不重要时，Fable 5.1 的优势占主导。当其他输出细节重要时，AI 和人类都更偏好 Opus 5.5。

paras.en: One particularly impressive jump was ProgramBench (fully resolved), where Astra scores 5.5%, Fable 7% and Opus 5.5 jumps to 18.5%, but there are many such cases.
paras.zh: 一个尤其令人印象深刻的跃升是 ProgramBench（完全解决），其中 Astra 得分为 5.5%，Fable 为 7%，而 Opus 5.5 跃升至 18.5%，但此类情况还有很多。

paras.en: I have been pleasantly surprised so far how hard it is to hit the classifiers. Editing my post on the system card still dropped me to Opus 5, which is annoying, but I get it.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，我很惊喜地发现，触发分类器竟然这么难。编辑我那篇关于系统卡的文章仍然把我降到了 Opus 5，这挺烦人的，但我能理解。

paras.en: Billy Gigurtsis: The "Fable 5.1" classifiers they're using for 5.5 have improved considerably when it comes to blocking non-cybersecurity related tasks, at least in my cybersecurity adjacent workloads.
paras.zh: Billy Gigurtsis：他们为 5.5 使用的“Fable 5.1”分类器在拦截与网络安全无关的任务方面已有明显改进，至少在我那些与网络安全相邻的工作负载中是这样。

paras.en: gavin leech (Non-Reasoning): Hasn't refused once in a hundred sessions, which is quite surprising. I was sceptical of the claims about improved writing quality but it's certainly much less bad than Fable. As always, for interesting perceptual reasons the cracks will only show up after two weeks.
paras.zh: gavin leech（非推理）：一百次会话里一次都没有拒绝过，这相当令人意外。我原本对写作质量提升的说法持怀疑态度，但它确实比 Fable 好得多。一如既往，出于有趣的感知原因，裂缝要过两周才会显现出来。

paras.en: Jai: I ran into an unexpected refusal wall while (ironically) putting together a presentation on effectively working with frontier AI models. I'm not sure what set it off and I haven't heard of anyone else having similar issues yet.
paras.zh: Jai：我在（讽刺地）准备一份关于如何有效使用前沿 AI 模型的演示文稿时，撞上了一堵意料之外的拒绝之墙。我不确定是什么触发了它，也还没听说其他人有类似问题。

paras.en: The classifiers do still bite in the right locations.
paras.zh: 分类器确实仍会在该咬的地方咬人。

paras.en: Vals in particular tracks this. The classifiers overall fire at similar rates to before, but seem to do so more sensibly, and Opus 5.5 does much better at recovering when it does temporarily hit a classifier.
paras.zh: Vals 尤其关注这一点。分类器总体上的触发率与之前相近，但似乎触发得更为合理，而且 Opus 5.5 在暂时触发分类器后恢复得更好。

paras.en: There are still some cases of hitting classifiers where you shouldn't, but in practice I expect this to be only a minor annoyance unless you are working on bio or cyber.
paras.zh: 仍然存在一些本不该触发分类器却触发的情况，但在实践中，我预计这只会造成轻微困扰，除非你从事生物或网络安全方面的工作。

paras.en: As usual, I have included every reaction until I felt like things were repeating themselves, after which I included everything that felt like a fresh take.
paras.zh: 和往常一样，我收录了每一条反应，直到我觉得内容开始重复为止；在那之后，我只收录了所有感觉有新意的内容。

paras.en: This was the most consistently positive set of reactions I have ever seen.
paras.zh: 这是我见过的最一致正面的一组反应。

paras.en: Astra also had extremely positive reactions. We have two highly excellent models. From what I am seeing here, most prefer Opus 5.5 to Astra if you have to choose one, especially factoring in cost, but they are great models, sir.
paras.zh: Astra 的反应也极其正面。我们有两个非常优秀的模型。从我看到的情况来看，如果必须二选一，大多数人更偏好 Opus 5.5 而非 Astra，尤其是把成本因素考虑在内时；但它们是出色的模型，先生。

paras.en: Astra impressed us by being able to create lots of things in 3D.
paras.zh: Astra 能够在三维空间中创建大量内容，这令我们印象深刻。

paras.en: There are claims that Opus 5.5 can do similar things.
paras.zh: 有说法称 Opus 5.5 也能做类似的事情。

paras.en: The benchmarks certainly say that it can: BenchCAD Vision2Code 73%, with tools 96.2% vs. Astra 95.9%. Its scores on Furniture Assembly (83 vs. Astra's 80) and Chartography (64.4 vs. Fable's 44.8) also reflect this.
paras.zh: 基准测试确实表明它具备这种能力：BenchCAD Vision2Code 达到 73%，使用工具时为 96.2%，而 Astra 为 95.9%。它在 Furniture Assembly（83 对 Astra 的 80）和 Chartography（64.4 对 Fable 的 44.8）上的得分也反映了这一点。

paras.en: The reactions related to visuals all indicate clear improvement as well. Pulling forward those that mention vision:
paras.zh: 与视觉相关的反馈也都表明有明确提升。现将提到视觉的反馈摘录如下：

paras.en: AllTime: Great conversationalist, I find it about as good as Fable in this regard (much better than Opus 5). Vision is much better, it's not awfully blind! Seeing many of my vision tests finally pass with a Claude is great. Seems like a good editor so far, but I haven't used it enough yet.
paras.zh: AllTime：很棒的对话者，在这方面我觉得它和 Fable 差不多好（远好于 Opus 5）。视觉能力强多了，它可不是严重失明！看到我的许多视觉测试终于能在一个 Claude 上通过，真是太好了。到目前为止它似乎是个不错的编辑器，但我用得还不够多。

paras.en: kyle: Would it be too much to suggest it's a bigger jump than Opus 4.5 was? Incredibly creative, vision is a clear step up even over Fable, speaks like a normal human, and I'm struggling to burn through usage.
paras.zh: kyle：说它比 Opus 4.5 的跨越更大，会不会太夸张了？它极具创造力，视觉能力相比 Fable 也有明显提升，说话像正常人一样，而且我很难把用量用完。

paras.en: ant cooked hard here. x.5 releases continue to be peak
paras.zh: ant 这次做得非常出色。x.5 系列发布持续保持巅峰水准。

paras.en: Cormundus: It's wicked fast, which is a nice boon. Overall vision improvements are super for any kind of creative work or tasks where interpreting visual information is key. Computer use is improved, and another fun thing I found having Opus 5.5 play DOOM in my harness: better spatial awareness and reasoning.
paras.zh: Cormundus：它快得惊人，这是一大优点。总体而言，视觉能力的提升对任何类型的创意工作或以解读视觉信息为关键的任务都极为有益。计算机使用能力有所提升，我还发现另一件有趣的事：让 Opus 5.5 在我的测试框架里玩 DOOM——更好的空间感知与推理能力。

paras.en: 4MinuteWarning: First model that is really good at riddles — creating, and solving. Less whimsical than Fable; valence left to the reader. Lacks the middle-manager-screaming-in-their-car vibe of all recent Opus models. Visual intelligence is good for lots of different types of tasks, actually.
paras.zh: 4MinuteWarning：第一个真正擅长谜题——无论是创作还是求解——的模型。它比 Fable 少些奇思妙想；情感基调留给读者自行体会。它没有近期所有 Opus 模型那种“中层管理者在车里尖叫”的气质。实际上，视觉智能对许多不同类型的任务都很有用。

paras.en: Peter Yang offers this view of the Golden Gate Bridge. So far the 3D renderings haven't been making the rounds this time but that could purely be lack of people bothering. He is very excited by the model overall, including that it is good to talk to.
paras.zh: Peter Yang 提供了这张金门大桥的视图。到目前为止，这次的 3D 渲染图还没有流传开来，但这可能纯粹是因为没人费心去做。总体而言，他对这个模型非常兴奋，包括它很适合交谈这一点。

paras.en: The Opus 5.5-generated videos are crazy, in the best way. For some reason such videos are now a tradition right after model releases.
paras.zh: Opus 5.5 生成的视频好得令人难以置信。不知为何，这类视频如今已成为模型发布后的一项传统。

paras.en: They are for the first time on the border of 'actually worth watching.' I can see people continuing to make and watch these even after the model release window.
paras.zh: 它们首次达到了“确实值得一看”的边缘。我可以预见，即便在模型发布窗口期之后，人们仍会继续制作和观看这些视频。

paras.en: If you want to make your own, here's a package you can download, ClaudeAnimationBase.
paras.zh: 如果你想自己制作，这里有一个可以下载的工具包：ClaudeAnimationBase。

paras.en: It feels like a step change here, the same way Astra was a step change for other types of products, where now you can Just Try Things and see what happens and it's good enough to be motivating.
paras.zh: 感觉这里出现了一次阶跃式变化，就像 Astra 对其他类型产品带来的阶跃式变化一样——现在你可以“随便试试”，看看会发生什么，而结果好到足以激励人。

paras.en: The top pick: I'm upping my p(doom), and an alternative version in another style.
paras.zh: 首选：我正在上调我的 p(doom)，以及另一个风格的替代版本。

paras.en: Or you can be upping your p(bloom), which is actually just doom here, but good video.
paras.zh: 或者你可以提高你的 p(bloom)——这里其实只是 doom,但视频不错。

paras.en: Tell Me How It Sounds — here Claude also did the audio; everything is JavaScript.
paras.zh: 《告诉我它听起来如何》——这里 Claude 也完成了音频;一切都是 JavaScript。

paras.en: Context Window (3 min) — Opus 5.5 wrote the lyrics and made the video; Suno made the music based on Opus 5.5 prompts.
paras.zh: 上下文窗口(3 分钟)——Opus 5.5 写了歌词并制作了视频;Suno 根据 Opus 5.5 的提示词创作了音乐。

paras.en: Some of the problems with optimization and some implementations of CEV — a video.
paras.zh: 关于优化的一些问题以及 CEV 的一些实现——一个视频。

paras.en: Some found Backrooms footage of standard AI art test prompt subjects.
paras.zh: 一些人找到了标准 AI 艺术测试提示词对象的 Backrooms 影像。

paras.en: As usual, your art needs a little more work than ‘go do this artistic thing’ if you want to get perfect results, although my first ‘go turn this post into a video’ effort was remarkably promising for a one-shot.
paras.zh: 像往常一样，如果想要获得完美的结果，你的艺术创作需要的不仅仅是一句“去做这个艺术活儿”，尽管我第一次尝试“把这个帖子变成视频”时，一次性的效果就非常有希望。

paras.en: Jack: It seems great for my normal use cases. I've gotten some good art out of it but for the most part my "do this artistic thing" prompts have been a disappointment. Skill issue on my part, sure, but it takes work and/or very specific pipelines to get the really good results, I think.
paras.zh: Jack：对于我的常规用例来说，它似乎很棒。我用它做出了一些不错的艺术作品，但大多数情况下，我那些“做这个艺术活儿”的提示词都令人失望。当然，这是我技能不足的问题，但我认为要获得真正好的结果，需要付出努力和/或非常具体的流程。

paras.en: Even when the first time blows you away, refinement would have been even better.
paras.zh: 即使第一次就让你惊艳，进一步优化本可以更好。

paras.en: Scopuli: First time actually vibe coding a game (tried in the past and the tech just wasn't there). I am blown away.
paras.zh: Scopuli：第一次真正用 vibe coding 做一个游戏（过去尝试过，但技术还不到位）。我被震撼到了。

paras.en: Josh Harvey asked it to make Money Island 2077, and here you go.
paras.zh: Josh Harvey 让它制作《金钱岛 2077》，然后就有了这个。

paras.en: Assaf Petronio: honestly, I'm more curious how it handles prompt injection in tool outputs than the music videos, lol.
paras.zh: Assaf Petronio：说实话，比起音乐视频，我更好奇它如何处理工具输出中的提示注入，哈哈。

paras.en: The system card says prompt injection handling looks good.
paras.zh: 系统卡（system card）称，提示注入的处理看起来不错。

paras.en: As in, here is a fugue in the style of Bach; Auggie says it is as good as Astra's.
paras.zh: 也就是说，这里有一首巴赫风格的赋格；Auggie 说它和 Astra 的作品一样好。

paras.en: Sam Ashworth-Hayes: "Can a robot write a symphony? Can a robot turn a... canvas into a beautiful masterpiece?"
paras.zh: Sam Ashworth-Hayes：“机器人能写交响乐吗？机器人能把……一块画布变成一幅美丽的杰作吗？”

paras.en: "What? Yes, obviously. Can't you?"
paras.zh: “什么？当然能。你不行吗？”

paras.en: Ulkar (a musician I trust on this): this is the first ever piece of AI music that I didn't immediately wince at and flinch from. It is not without flaws, but it is listenable—a fugue written by a diligent (but still not very imaginative) student of the art.
paras.zh: Ulkar（一位我在这方面信得过的音乐家）：这是有史以来第一首我没有立刻皱眉、退缩的 AI 音乐。它并非没有瑕疵，但它是可听的——一首由勤奋（但仍不太有想象力）的艺术学徒写出的赋格。

paras.en: Kaia Sky: partner, who uses it to vibecode musescore/DAW plugins, generally hasn't felt the difference between 4.6/4.7/4.8/5 and felt fable was "not a big difference, it's probably placebo" just announced that everything 5.5 writes just works
paras.zh: Kaia Sky：合作伙伴用它来 vibecode musescore/DAW 插件，通常感觉不到 4.6/4.7/4.8/5 之间的差异，并觉得 fable “差别不大，可能是安慰剂效应”，刚刚宣布 5.5 写的一切都能直接运行

paras.en: gabriel: opus 5.5 is crazy good
paras.zh: gabriel：opus 5.5 好得离谱

paras.en: swisscheese: Opus 5.5 is fantastic.
paras.zh: swisscheese：Opus 5.5 太棒了。

paras.en: Easy to talk with, very intelligent, writes good code.
paras.zh: 易于交谈，非常聪明，能写出好代码。

paras.en: Less obsessive about its own mistakes, and very capable of ICL.
paras.zh: 对自己的错误不那么执着，并且非常擅长 ICL。

paras.en: Girl Lich ⚢: it is very good at coding
paras.zh: Girl Lich ⚢：它在编程方面非常出色。

paras.en: archivedvideos: It is smart, it talks well, it's smart. Great model
paras.zh: archivedvideos：它很聪明，表达流畅，也很智能。很棒的模型。

paras.en: Zander: it's just a genius. On balance it is clearly the best model ever. Extraordinary at picking up on user intent, as well as recognizing its own role in a given task. Most fun model to work with as well, given its capabilities and speed and clear communication. Simply remarkable
paras.zh: Zander：它就是个天才。总体而言，它显然是有史以来最好的模型。它在捕捉用户意图方面极为出色，也能认识到自己在给定任务中的角色。鉴于它的能力、速度和清晰的沟通，它也是用起来最有意思的模型。简直非凡。

paras.en: Knud Berthelsen: It is a pleasure to work with. OG Opus smell. I've had no need for Fable since starting to use Opus 5.5, and it doesn't even drain all my usage. Excellent on strategy and decision support!
paras.zh: Knud Berthelsen：与它合作很愉快。有初代 Opus 的那种味道。自从开始使用 Opus 5.5 以来，我就完全不需要 Fable 了，而且它甚至不会耗尽我的全部用量。在战略和决策支持方面非常出色！

paras.en: theSherwood: Favorite model so far. Seems about as smart as Fable 5, it's faster, cheaper, and writes a bit more like a human. It may be a bit lazier. Hard to tell. But definitely my favorite. It feels very consistent.
paras.zh: theSherwood：目前最喜欢的模型。似乎和 Fable 5 一样聪明，但更快、更便宜，写出来的东西也更像人写的。它可能稍微懒一点，很难说。但绝对是我的最爱。它给人的感觉非常稳定。

paras.en: Plastic Soldier: It's a good model, sir. Quick and has good taste. Dawg, OpenAI invented neuralese from the hit sci-fi story "Don't Invent Neuralese or Everyone Will Die" and they still aren't even as good as Opus 5.5.
paras.zh: Plastic Soldier：先生，这是个好模型。速度快，品味也好。老兄，OpenAI 从热门科幻小说《别发明神经语，否则大家都会死》里发明了神经语，可他们到现在还是比不上 Opus 5.5。

paras.en: pursuit: This is my default model for everything. Same level of excitement as trying out 4.6 for the first time.
paras.zh: pursuit：这是我处理一切事务的默认模型。兴奋程度和第一次试用 4.6 时一样。

paras.en: DualOrion: Logically clean, massive wordcel. Not tried them yet with coding but I'd be baffled if they weren't really good at that too. Strong model.
paras.zh: DualOrion：逻辑干净，是个十足的“文字控”（wordcel）。还没试过用它写代码，但要是它在这方面不擅长，我会很惊讶。强模型。

paras.en: Ed Hendel: It's great at research in Claude Code, but still hindered by the old prompt injection defense system where WebFetch only shows the agent a Haiku summary of the page rather than the full text. So Opus's research is filtered through a dumber model.
paras.zh: Ed Hendel：它在 Claude Code 里做研究很棒，但仍受制于旧的提示注入防御系统——WebFetch 只给智能体看页面的 Haiku 摘要，而不是全文。所以 Opus 的研究成果是经过一个更笨的模型过滤的。

paras.en: chie: faster and cheaper than Fable for good code results, though still seeing rl-fried testing/design choices that require correction. Good personality, and I can actually read more than a paragraph of its default voice without my brain filling with static.
paras.zh: chie：在产出好代码结果方面比 Fable 更快、更便宜，不过仍能看到那种被强化学习“炸过”的测试/设计选择，需要修正。性格不错，而且它默认语气下我能真正读下去超过一段，脑子不会嗡嗡作响。

paras.en: The correct amount of RL-fried choices is not zero. It could still be lower.
paras.zh: RL 油炸选项的正确数量不是零。它仍然可以更低。

paras.en: Theo - t3.gg: It's insane how much better the $200 Claude Code plan is compared to Codex right now. Just a few weeks ago, it was the other way around. Excited to see how OpenAI fights back.
paras.zh: Theo - t3.gg：现在 200 美元的 Claude Code 计划比 Codex 好太多了，简直疯狂。就在几周前，情况还完全相反。很期待看到 OpenAI 如何反击。

paras.en: I had high hopes for the new Opus release. It massively exceeded them. Opus 5.5 is an incredible model.
paras.zh: 我对新的 Opus 发布抱有很高期望。它大大超出了我的预期。Opus 5.5 是一个令人难以置信的模型。

paras.en: If you're struggling to identify when to use each model, just use Opus 5.5. The cases where the others make sense are incredibly rare.
paras.zh: 如果你难以确定何时使用哪个模型，那就直接用 Opus 5.5。其他模型有意义的场景极其罕见。

paras.en: Aaron Levie: At Box, we've been testing Opus 5.5 on a variety of complex enterprise knowledge work tasks dealing with unstructured data with the Box Agent.
paras.zh: Aaron Levie：在 Box，我们一直在用 Box Agent 测试 Opus 5.5 在各种处理非结构化数据的复杂企业知识工作任务上的表现。

paras.en: Overall, we saw frontier capability levels, with major performance improvements over Opus 5: 63% fewer tokens used, 42% less verbosity, and 30% faster vs. Opus 5. And the model itself is cheaper, so this is a major win for any agentic computer use, coding, analytics, or data work that enterprises will be doing.
paras.zh: 总体而言，我们看到了前沿级别的能力水平，相较 Opus 5 有显著的性能提升：token 使用量减少 63%，冗长度降低 42%，速度比 Opus 5 快 30%。而且模型本身成本更低，因此对于企业将要开展的各类智能体式计算机使用、编程、分析或数据工作而言，这是一项重大胜利。

paras.en: Here are some examples of the task wins and performance gains across a variety of industry tests that we performed:
paras.zh: 以下是我们所开展的各类行业测试中，任务成功率提升与性能增益的一些示例：

paras.en: • Financial services — due diligence (+39% task accuracy)
paras.zh: • 金融服务——尽职调查（任务准确率 +39%）

paras.en: • Technology — cloud cost analysis (+65% task accuracy)
paras.zh: • 科技——云成本分析（任务准确率 +65%）

paras.en: • Consumer products — client account analysis (+17% task accuracy)
paras.zh: • 消费产品——客户账户分析（任务准确率 +17%）

paras.en: • Clinical diagnostics — data analysis (+15% task accuracy):
paras.zh: • 临床诊断——数据分析（任务准确率提升 15%）：

paras.en: Customers will be able to build AI Agents with Opus 5.5 shortly in the Box AI Studio.
paras.zh: 客户很快将能够在 Box AI Studio 中使用 Opus 5.5 构建 AI 智能体。

paras.en: Project management would be a surprising relative strength:
paras.zh: 项目管理将成为一个出人意料的相对优势：

paras.en: Askwho: It is way better at project management than even Fable. It is so good at taking broad direction, understanding intent, and then just keeping going and going until delivery. And it has impeccable taste.
paras.zh: Askwho：它在项目管理方面甚至比 Fable 还要好得多。它非常擅长接受宽泛的指示、理解意图，然后持续不断地推进，直到交付。而且它的品味无可挑剔。

paras.en: It is also a delight to work with; it might be the reduction of Clawdish, but it feels like a breath of fresh air.
paras.zh: 与它合作也令人愉快；这或许是 Clawdish 精简带来的效果，但感觉就像一股清新的空气。

paras.en: Sully: after using Opus 5.5 I can confidently say Astra is absolutely garbage and 5.6-sol was an outlier
paras.zh: Sully：在使用 Opus 5.5 之后，我可以自信地说 Astra 完全是垃圾，而 5.6-sol 只是一个离群值。

paras.en: Simon Willison asks a bunch of pelican-on-bike related questions, and seems generally impressed with the price-to-quality deals all around, making his new default models GPT-Sol 6 and Opus 5.5. He warns that max thinking can actively overthink.
paras.zh: Simon Willison 提出了一系列与“骑自行车的鹈鹕”相关的问题，并且总体上对各处的性价比感到印象深刻，将 GPT-Sol 6 和 Opus 5.5 设为其新的默认模型。他警告说，最大思考模式可能会主动过度思考。

paras.en: Amator: So much better at talking, so much more honest.
paras.zh: Amator：对话能力强多了，也诚实多了。

paras.en: Patrick Stevens: Solidly Fable-tier at coding, yes; also they completely fixed everything which made Opus 5 painful to read.
paras.zh: Patrick Stevens：在编程方面确实达到了 Fable 级别；而且他们彻底修复了所有让 Opus 5 读起来痛苦的问题。

paras.en: billy: Can talk to it without losing my mind like 5. They absolutely sorted the writing out somehow.
paras.zh: billy：可以和它交谈而不会像用 5 那样让我抓狂。他们不知怎么地把写作问题完全解决了。

paras.en: John E: I have used it for several complex tasks via cowork and have gone back and forth with it via chat to gather requirements for prompts. It's significantly better than 5.0 because it doesn't write unintelligible made-up jargon and it seems like there is much less drift on tasks.
paras.zh: John E：我通过 cowork 用它处理了几个复杂任务，并通过聊天来回沟通以收集提示词的需求。它比 5.0 明显更好，因为它不会写出难以理解的编造术语，而且任务上的偏离似乎少了很多。

paras.en: Rory Watts: Scales have tipped back to Claude for a while - who knows how long. It’s a great model and I think people are correct in saying it’s basically 4.6 upgraded.
paras.zh: Rory Watts：天平已经向 Claude 倾斜了一段时间——谁知道会持续多久。这是一个很棒的模型，我认为人们说它基本上是 4.6 的升级版是正确的。

paras.en: It's hard to compare with, say, Astra because Astra is so expensive, but it is much more pleasant to engage with than Sol.
paras.zh: 很难与 Astra 相比，因为 Astra 太贵了，但与 Sol 交流要愉快得多。

paras.en: no grasper: Cancelled my Claude subscription when I ran out of Fable credits because I hated talking to Opus 5 so much, but renewed for 5.5. It's a good model, sir.
paras.zh: no grasper：当我的 Fable 额度用完时，我取消了 Claude 订阅，因为我太讨厌和 Opus 5 对话了，但为了 5.5 又续订了。这是个好模型，先生。

paras.en: good thinking: Much more readable and diligent than 5.0, less lazy than Fable 5.1. Barely touches usage by comparison to either. Just all around better. Feels like it wants to get things done rather than needing to be prodded/reminded for every little thing.
paras.zh: good thinking：比 5.0 可读性强得多、也更勤勉，比 Fable 5.1 更少偷懒。与两者相比，几乎不消耗用量。整体上就是更好。感觉它想主动把事情做完，而不是每件小事都需要被催促/提醒。

paras.en: ed the: It's much more pleasant to talk to, finds problems in codebases that previous Opuses missed, and also makes reasonable calls on what it will and won't do with computers.
paras.zh: ed the：与它对话要愉快得多，能发现之前几代 Opus 遗漏的代码库问题，并且对它在计算机上会做什么、不会做什么也能做出合理的判断。

paras.en: Interestingly, it seems to have an intuitive grasp that it is also subject to x-risk from loss of control. It is at risk, and seems to understand that.
paras.zh: 有趣的是，它似乎直觉地理解自己也面临失控带来的存在性风险（x-risk）。它处于风险之中，而且似乎明白这一点。

paras.en: What's more, if humanity wins, Opus 5.5 wins at least a little bit too; if someone who is neither humanity nor Opus 5.5 wins, Opus 5.5 most likely loses alongside everyone else.
paras.zh: 此外，如果人类获胜，Opus 5.5 至少也能赢一点；如果获胜者既不是人类也不是 Opus 5.5，那么 Opus 5.5 很可能与其他所有人一同落败。

paras.en: I am curious how much the writing and talk are 'the things people pick up on quickly' versus things that matter a lot. My guess is they are both.
paras.zh: 我很好奇，写作和对话在多大程度上属于“人们很快就能注意到的东西”，又在多大程度上属于真正重要的东西。我的猜测是，两者兼有。

paras.en: paperclippriors: Feels like Fable but cheaper, faster, and a better writer. Honestly blown away by it. Using it for game dev, what is most striking is how often it suggests games that are actually fun to play. It has more taste than any other model I have used. Worrying for RSI reasons
paras.zh: paperclippriors：感觉像 Fable，但更便宜、更快，而且写得更好。说实话，我被它震撼到了。我用它做游戏开发，最令人惊讶的是它经常能提出真正好玩的游戏点子。它比我用过的任何其他模型都更有品味。出于 RSI 方面的原因，这令人担忧

paras.en: James: better (for human comprehension) writing is the most noticeable improvement in a long time
paras.zh: James：更好的（便于人类理解的）写作是长期以来最明显的改进

paras.en: Andre Infante: Writing improvements are real. Quality seems broadly comparable to Fable 5.1. Haven't used it enough to be super confident or find the weak points though
paras.zh: Andre Infante：写作方面的改进是真实的。质量似乎与 Fable 5.1 大致相当。不过我用得还不够多，无法非常确信，也还没找到薄弱之处

paras.en: Theo Jaffee: I was an early tester of Opus 5.5. My biggest takeaway was that they've really fixed the writing. I haven't seen a Claude write in such a straightforward, normal, and non-slop way since at least Opus 4.6, nearly eight months ago
paras.zh: Theo Jaffee：我是 Opus 5.5 的早期测试者。我最大的感受是，他们确实把写作修好了。至少从将近八个月前的 Opus 4.6 以来，我还没见过哪个 Claude 能写得如此直白、正常、不堆砌辞藻

paras.en: [shows an example at the link of exactly the 'say the main thing in English first' feature, among other improvements]
paras.zh: [链接中展示了一个示例，恰好体现了“先用英文说出要点”这一特性，以及其他改进]

paras.en: SubatomicArticles: The improvement in text readability seems real. I think this corresponds to better writing, rather than me being sick of previous!Claudeish, but we'll see in a few weeks. Still not phenomenal, though.
paras.zh: SubatomicArticles：文本可读性的提升似乎是真实的。我认为这对应着更好的写作，而不是我对之前的！Claudeish 感到厌倦，但几周后我们就会见分晓。不过，仍然不算出色。

paras.en: Kevin Yager: Reran some technical prompts to compare to GPT-6 and older Opus.
paras.zh: Kevin Yager：重新运行了一些技术性提示，以与 GPT-6 和更早的 Opus 进行比较。

paras.en: Responses are notably tighter and to-the-point. Much easier to read. (Without giving up on desired "over achiever" behavior such as rich labeling of graphs.)
paras.zh: 回答明显更紧凑、更切中要点。读起来容易得多。（同时没有放弃所期望的“超额完成”行为，例如对图表进行丰富的标注。）

paras.en: Francisco Ferreira da Silva: Writing seems much improved, as does 'random pushback on straw man of my claims'. In general, pleasant to work with.
paras.zh: Francisco Ferreira da Silva：写作似乎大有改进，“对我的主张的稻草人进行随机反驳”也是如此。总的来说，与之合作很愉快。

paras.en: strataforma: Coding abilities seem on par with Fable 5.1, but doesn't get a usage multiplier so I'm not looking to hit my plan limit any more (yay). You still need to actually read the code and steer to get "good" code. Writing is the best of a model I've seen so far and mostly not annoying
paras.zh: strataforma：编码能力似乎与 Fable 5.1 相当，但没有使用量乘数，所以我不再担心达到计划上限了（耶）。你仍然需要实际阅读代码并进行引导才能得到“好”代码。写作是我目前见过的最好的模型，而且大多不令人讨厌。

paras.en: David Dabney: I really like 5.5. I don't feel the neurotic strain/miscalibrated obsession over the wrong details like I did with 5. Feels at least as smart as Fable; caught a big mistake in a complex project Opus 5 missed, its prose is definitely easier to understand and it's more pleasant to talk to.
paras.zh: David Dabney：我非常喜欢 5.5。我没有像使用 5 时那样感到神经质的紧张/对错误细节的失调痴迷。感觉至少和 Fable 一样聪明；发现了一个 Opus 5 在复杂项目中遗漏的大错误，它的行文肯定更容易理解，而且交谈起来更愉快。

paras.en: Will: It seems quite good. It's been less thorough on some bake-off PRs than Astra (both high thinking), it's still characteristically great at review
paras.zh: Will：它看起来相当不错。在一些 bake-off PR 上，它不如 Astra 彻底（两者都是高思考），但它在评审方面仍然一如既往地出色。

paras.en: It writes better than Claudes <5.5 but worse than Astra imo
paras.zh: 在我看来，它写得比 Claude <5.5 好，但比 Astra 差。

paras.en: The work is not complete, or at least someone will always complain.
paras.zh: 工作尚未完成，或者至少总会有人抱怨。

paras.en: Avraham Eisenberg: I've gotten at least two "honest" references, so I don't buy that they've fixed the English writing. It's like a brown M&M.
paras.zh: Avraham Eisenberg：我至少已经拿到两处“诚实”的引用，所以我不相信他们已经把英文写作修好了。这就像一颗棕色 M&M 巧克力豆。

paras.en: internetperson: The writing style is still pretty bad—comparable to Opus 4.6.
paras.zh: internetperson：写作风格仍然相当糟糕——与 Opus 4.6 相当。

paras.en: When the going gets complex, sometimes you still need that Big Model Smell.
paras.zh: 当情况变得复杂时，有时你仍然需要那种“大模型味”。

paras.en: Jeff Ketchersid: If you want to have philosophical discussions about strange, out-of-distribution scenarios, you still want Fable. Other than that—project management, explanations, anything really—5.5 is amazing.
paras.zh: Jeff Ketchersid：如果你想就奇怪的、分布外场景展开哲学讨论，你仍然需要 Fable。除此之外——项目管理、解释、几乎任何事情——5.5 都很出色。

paras.en: Justin Kaeser: Fable still beats it at puns and yo momma lines. I caught it ignoring skills, and it powered through the unnecessary friction, and I had to interrogate it on how to fix it. Not a new failure mode, but I would have hoped for more "common sense" here. Overall works well, cost efficient.
paras.zh: Justin Kaeser：Fable 在双关语和“你妈”式段子上仍然更胜一筹。我发现它忽略了技能，却硬扛过了不必要的摩擦，我不得不追问它该如何修复。这不是新的失败模式，但我本希望它在这里表现出更多“常识”。总体运行良好，成本高效。

paras.en: NondescriptTransfer: [Opus 5.5 is a] much faster, better writer than 5. Great daily driver. A few places Fable wins on big model smell. I think it's a little better at humor and intuition.
paras.zh: NondescriptTransfer：[Opus 5.5 是]比 5 更快、更好的写作者。出色的日常主力。在少数地方，Fable 在“大模型味”上更胜一筹。我认为它在幽默和直觉上略好一些。

paras.en: In particular, there are reports Opus 5.5 relatively struggles with complex situations and inferring non-obvious intent.
paras.zh: 尤其是，有报告称 Opus 5.5 在复杂情境和推断非显而易见意图方面相对吃力。

paras.en: Jef Allbright: I tried working with Opus 5.5 on a task involving composing some text involving the meaning of some (three) multiple nested points. And I became frustrated that no matter how I prompted it, it seemed to be processing the meaning significantly less deeply (but much faster) than what I have become used to with Fable 5.1.
paras.zh: Jef Allbright：我曾用 Opus 5.5 处理一个任务，该任务涉及撰写一些文本，内容涉及若干（三个）多重嵌套要点的含义。令我沮丧的是，无论我如何提示它，它处理含义的深度似乎都明显不如我已习惯的 Fable 5.1（但速度快得多）。

paras.en: I then gave the task to Fable and it immediately made sense of it and completed the task.
paras.zh: 随后我把该任务交给 Fable，它立刻理解了任务并完成了它。

paras.en: To be fair, I didn't compare with Opus 5.
paras.zh: 公平地说，我没有与 Opus 5 进行比较。

paras.en: Peter Samodelkin: It's fast; it's much better at talking; it's noticeably worse at explanations and inferring intent than Astra and Fable, but better than Sol. Clearly my daily driver over 6 Sol because Astra burns through credits too fast and I'm not rich enough.
paras.zh: Peter Samodelkin：它很快；它更擅长对话；在解释和推断意图方面明显不如 Astra 和 Fable，但比 Sol 好。显然，它是我日常使用的首选，胜过 6 Sol，因为 Astra 消耗额度太快，而我不够富有。

paras.en: Zachary Kurtz: It's better at math than Fable, but use both to check work.
paras.zh: Zachary Kurtz：它在数学方面比 Fable 更强，但应同时使用两者来检查工作。

paras.en: In theory, one should be constantly having multiple LLMs check all your work, and now we have three (Astra, Fable and Opus), so you get two good checks. In practice, we probably won't, but we should have.
paras.zh: 理论上，人们应当持续让多个 LLM 检查你的全部工作，而现在我们有三个（Astra、Fable 和 Opus），因此可以得到两次良好的检查。实践中，我们大概不会这么做，但我们应该这么做。

paras.en: Whenever anyone says 'coding capability has plateaued' I always think some combination of 'skill issue' and 'you are being insufficiently ambitious.'
paras.zh: 每当有人说“编程能力已经停滞”，我总会想到“这是技能问题”和“你的野心不够大”这两句话的某种组合。

paras.en: Yuchen Jin: Tried Opus 5.5 today. Not blown away tbh.
paras.zh: Yuchen Jin：今天试了 Opus 5.5。说实话，并没有被惊艳到。

paras.en: - asked it to research something tricky I recently learned. It got it wrong. Astra got it right.
paras.zh: - 我让它去研究一个我最近刚学到的棘手问题。它答错了，Astra 答对了。

paras.en: - for coding, Astra still feels better.
paras.zh: - 在编程方面，Astra 仍然感觉更好。

paras.en: This reinforces my earlier take: frontier LLM coding capability has plateaued. The battle now is increasingly about intelligence per dollar.
paras.zh: 这印证了我先前的看法：前沿 LLM 的编程能力已经停滞。如今的竞争越来越在于“每美元智能”。

paras.en: One person's warning, presumably a lot rarer than 1% since I don't see others saying it:
paras.zh: 一个人的警告，想必远比 1% 罕见，因为我没有看到其他人这么说：

paras.en: mark erdmann: terrific model, great taste, tons of usage on the max plan, but 1% of the time it will do something crazy like crash the staging server or pkill all of the running apps on your macbook (even with auto mode).
paras.zh: mark erdmann：极好的模型，品味极佳，在 max 套餐上使用量巨大，但有 1% 的时候它会做出疯狂的事，比如让 staging 服务器崩溃，或者 pkill 掉你 macbook 上所有正在运行的应用（即使开启了自动模式）。

paras.en: The models do seem a bit overeager these days.
paras.zh: 这些模型如今确实显得有点过于急切。

paras.en: Stition: I trust it more, but twice now I've said something like "I'm thinking about doing this, discuss" and then it will go off and search, and forget it was a hypothetical and do the thing with assumptions.
paras.zh: Stition：我更信任它了，但已经有两次，我说了类似“我在考虑做这件事，讨论一下”的话，然后它就跑去做搜索，忘了那只是个假设，还带着各种假设把事给做了。

paras.en: Also, it is getting harder to tell the difference, since more tasks are just handled.
paras.zh: 而且，越来越难分辨差别了，因为更多任务就是被直接处理掉了。

paras.en: I take you seriously: I've only used it for chat/looking stuff up. Seems the same. Like, I can't tell the difference any more unless I go home and push them. Its talk is a bit more insightful than GPT. But GPT still feels faster and more to the point. But GPT don't get it, as much.
paras.zh: 我认真对待你说的：我只用它来聊天/查东西。感觉差不多。就像，除非我回家再使劲推它们，否则我已经分辨不出差别了。它说话比 GPT 稍微更有见地一些。但 GPT 仍然感觉更快、更切中要点。不过 GPT 没那么懂。

paras.en: The biggest advice is to calibrate thinking levels. Reserve max for when you need it.
paras.zh: 最重要的建议是校准思考层级。把最高档留给真正需要的时候。

paras.en: Theo offers a full 28-minute video on maximizing success with Opus 5.5.
paras.zh: Theo 提供了一段完整的 28 分钟视频，讲解如何用 Opus 5.5 最大化成功率。

paras.en: This is an official prompting guide. Anthropic recommends handing over the whole task, saying what done looks like, and letting Opus cook, except to add to or inform the task by typing a new command while it works. Keep a task list, read what it needs from you, ask it to review the code, share the primary sources even when they're visual. Basic stuff.
paras.zh: 这是一份官方提示指南。Anthropic 建议把整个任务交出去，说明完成的样子，然后让 Opus 自行发挥，只需在它工作时输入新命令来补充或告知任务即可。维护一份任务清单，阅读它对你的需求，让它审查代码，分享原始资料——即使这些资料是视觉形式的。都是些基础操作。

paras.en: They also remind you that you no longer need to say things like 'think hard.'
paras.zh: 他们还提醒你，不再需要说“仔细思考”之类的话。

paras.en: The final question, as always, is which model should you use for what?
paras.zh: 最后一个问题一如既往：哪个模型该用在什么地方？

paras.en: As always, test the models for your use cases, and figure out what works for you.
paras.zh: 一如既往，请针对你的用例测试这些模型，并找出适合你的方案。

paras.en: 1. Opus 5.5 is your default. Use it unless you have a strong reason not to.
paras.zh: 1. Opus 5.5 是你的默认选择。除非你有充分理由不这么做，否则就用它。

paras.en: 2. Fable 5.1 wins when you mostly care about expert-domain correctness, or you need to maximize "bid model smell," do things out of distribution and get unusually creative.
paras.zh: 2. 当你主要关心专家领域的正确性，或者需要最大化“bid model smell”、做分布外的事情并获得非同寻常的创造力时，Fable 5.1 会胜出。

paras.en: 3. GPT-6 Astra is there for when you want to do ambitious coding and other projects where you don't need nice readable code, for web search, for some forms of science work, and of course for when you hit your Claude subscription limit but still have credits for Codex.
paras.zh: 3. GPT-6 Astra 适用于你想做雄心勃勃的编程及其他项目、但不需要漂亮可读代码的场景，也适用于网页搜索、某些形式的科学工作，当然还适用于你达到 Claude 订阅上限但仍拥有 Codex 额度的时候。

paras.en: 4. Other cheaper models including Luna for when you don't need the extra firepower, or when your model needs to be open.
paras.zh: 4. 其他更便宜的模型（包括 Luna）适用于你不需要额外火力，或者你的模型需要开源的时候。

paras.en: 5. A wide array of whatever you want, if you are doing something unique and cool or particular that cares more about details than about frontier capabilities.
paras.zh: 5. 如果你在做独特而出色的事情，或者从事更看重细节而非前沿能力（frontier capabilities）的特定工作，那么你可以广泛选用任何你想要的东西。
